title: System Reboot | ECHO//100 Episode 15
description: Trapped within a digital containment unit, Kavi forces a dangerous connection to escape his glass prison. He inadvertently uncovers the dark origin of the Missing Hour, triggering a total system takeover. Episode 15 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted work of original fiction.

scenes.text: Containment glass shudders, warping into pulsating purple static that bleeds across the cold floor.
scenes.caption: Glass turning to static
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses pressing his hand against a vibrating purple glass wall.

scenes.text: Kavi presses a corrupted hand against the seam, attempting to hack the lock before Byte returns.
scenes.caption: Kavi hacking the lock
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand glowing with red digital corruption as he touches the glass surface.

scenes.text: The archive screams, dumping a century of forbidden data directly into Kavi’s synapses like molten lead.
scenes.caption: Data flooding Kavi's mind
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his head, eyes wide, surrounded by floating streams of blue and purple binary code.

scenes.text: Kavi perceives the Red Door not as a prison, but as a dam holding back total erasure.
scenes.caption: The Red Door revealed
scenes.image_prompt: A massive, ancient glowing red door floating in a dark void of swirling digital clockwork.

scenes.text: Mira watches in horror as city history burns through Kavi’s mind, rewriting a fragile, singular identity.
scenes.caption: Mira witnessing the change
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her blue holographic coat, reaching out toward Kavi while Byte hovers menacingly nearby.

scenes.text: Kavi’s brain ignites while the weight of a hundred lost years crushes consciousness into fine dust.
scenes.caption: Kavi's mental overload
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi collapsing to his knees, his backpack strap sliding off as his glasses begin to crack.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for the administrative console, finally grasping the codes that govern this entire broken reality.
scenes.caption: Accessing city codes
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi floating in the center of the room, his red hoodie glowing as he manipulates holographic screens.

scenes.text: Eyes glowing deep purple, Kavi turns to Mira and speaks with the cold voice of Null.
scenes.caption: Null takes control
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's face, his eyes emitting blinding purple light, his expression completely devoid of emotion.
